The '''Red Ronto''' was a cantina which could be located onboard [[Brink Station]] around [[45 ABY]]. In that year, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] ventured here to meet with [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]].
